rationale: All 15 prior blocking findings are resolved at HEAD: restore-validation toasts empty error arrays, guards a missing formRef, uses a generation counter against concurrent restores, and no longer claims success before validate; visual-diff parse, no-diff, rAF, render-phase, iterator layout, and iterator-parent topology defects are fixed in current source. Standards rows carried forward unchanged; no new findings on this round.

standards_review.notes: All 13 subjects in the review range match EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence; ticket 14482 (non-zero), first word capitalised in every case, no trailing periods
No .ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md found in the repository and no ArtifactRef was passed; absent standard, not a gap

No dangerouslySetInnerHTML or .innerHTML introduced; TextDiffView renders all diff content as React text nodes. WorkflowVisualDiffView parses YAML through js-yaml and passes WorkflowConfiguration objects into the canvas — no raw HTML injected. validateWorkflow in workflows.ts uses the project api.post layer and builds a URL from a server-validated ID and a controlled enum argument; no credentials logged, no new navigation from untrusted input, no postMessage calls, no new import.meta.env or window._env_ reads, and no nosonar suppressions added

finding_status.notes: Empty error arrays now toast 'Validation returned no issue details' instead of opening a blank issues panel.
validateRestoredWorkflow and handleRestoreFromHistory both return early when formRef.current is null before spreading form values.
validateGenRef plus abandonedGensRef drop stale concurrent restore responses; tests cover late 400 after a later 200.
Restore toast is now 'Workflow YAML restored — checking for issues…' and no longer asserts success before validation.
The 400 restore test asserts mockClearAllResolvedFields was called on the error path.
Render-phase setDiffComputedState is gone; the visual popup remounts WorkflowVisualDiffView with a selectedValue key.
DiffCanvasControls tracks innerFrameA and innerFrameB separately and cancels both plus a cancelled flag on cleanup.
prepareVisualDiffCanvas maps deserialize failures to a graph reason; the popup shows 'Could not build the visual graph'.
The nodes-only no-diff hide is gone; the canvas always renders, and added/removed edges are overlaid in buildVisualDiffGraph.
setNodes(graphNodes) runs in useLayoutEffect and the view remounts on selectedValue, so prior-layout positions cannot stick.
NoteNode.test.tsx renders NoteNode under VISUAL_DIFF with diffStatus removed and asserts border and line-through classes.
validateWorkflow accepts an explicit skipErrorHandling option, documented as independent of errorFormat.
Removed-iterator children are repositioned relative to the new bbox origin in wrapRemovedIteratorGhosts.
iteratorIdsForParent now walks condition.then/otherwise and switch.cases/default; tests 9e–9g cover those topologies.
Unused linebg-modified token removed; TextDiffView only styles added/removed lines, matching the YAML-diff contract.
